summary: The Flutter administration section navigation now exposes a named tablist and each of its four choices as a tab with selected state, matching the web AdminPanel nav and aria-current behavior. Pointer interactions continue to select the same sections.

checks.name: Accessible tablist and selected tab
checks.observation: The widget test checks the navigation's tabBar role, the Media control's tab role and selected state after opening it, and confirms no layout/test exception at 390 dp width.

checks.name: Admin section regression coverage
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/admin_media_widget_test.dart test/admin_topology_widget_test.dart
checks.observation: All six media and topology widget tests passed, including pointer selection and stale-revision recovery.

checks.name: Windows runner validation
checks.observation: Push this UI code to run Flutter Windows CI on boohtacord-win-station; the test, analysis and Release build steps must pass.

checks.name: Native screen-reader acceptance
checks.observation: Semantic tree assertions pass. VoiceOver and TalkBack focus order and spoken selected-state behavior have not been checked on physical/native devices.

remaining: Verify the GitVerse Windows runner after push, then accept VoiceOver and TalkBack announcements and compare the section navigation visually against the web at desktop and compact Android widths.
